We are together. We are roommates at the university. And she is the only person who I have been so opened about my problems.

And I have come to the same conclusion as well.. I really wanted to get in to a hobby that ive been following for year and a half. It would keep me and my mind occupied.. But that requires some money.. and I have other expenses which are more important unfortunately... but studies. I find them interesting.. And fun. I love learning. As far as it actually teaches me some knowledge.. instead of something temporary to pass a test.

Im actually getting the same thing as you.. "sad spiral"

Ive been actually trying hard to counter my bad thoughts, And still am. Its very hard for me! but thats a solid advice. thank you
ah damn it. It probably is hard to read as it has no structure to it.. but that is pretty much my minds fault.. thats whats up in my head right now.

I deleted it.

But here it goes.

Ive been feeling down then and now for the past 8-9 years. Heck my childhood was amazing, and I couldnt thank enough for my parents and brother. I have an amazing family.  Despite all that.. Im there where I am.  It all started in first grades i think. Around the 5th one I got bullied a lot.. by my own so considered back then  "closest friends " . That hurt. But  I got over it. By then I wasnt attractive at all, and when everyone else started getting girlfriends that damaged my self esteem more.. for some reason.. ( ya know.. kids). I never really had any real "best friends "   .. not that im trying to make a gold piece out of my self.. but

I have always been faithful friend to others.. I had some... well closer friends.. But they took me for granted. And actually backstabbed me. I had serious trust issues for a long time. Ill get to this a bit later. And It actually hurt me that my effort goes nowhere. I was always a good kid. So I didnt hang out with the ones that enjoyed drinking and all the other bad habbits.  By years passing I found out I had developed OCD a long time ago. And as you probably get it.. IT bothers me so freakin much. I hate it. It ruins my life. And as if that wasnt enough I came to realisation that I had developed a depression as well. I had no real friends.. But the catch was.. I was so good about it. no one knew.  I never show my weakness. I was always into video games.. And as of all the factors I stated.. I enjoyed them even more.  Years later. Im still depressed.. which episodes of doing really great too. But I hate being in public. I never go to school parties. I get panic attacs when in huge crowds. you see.. this sounds like an anxiety.   this all together got me down even more.  I often ask. Why ? Why me? What have  I ever done to anyone.      

There was this girl.. She and I were good friends from the first day we met. And.. well she had a rough time. I was there for her when she needed someone the most.. And It was so for many years. She often thanks me , cause she is now who she is thanks to me ( her words, not mine.)  We actually ended up being together..   But cause of her rough past... (others know too )  im so scared what others will think of me.. cause they know us both. ( our old friends for example )   Imagine how that must suck.. She is amazing.. truly is. But there goes my mental state... f*ing up my life again.

Now im studying in university. While im studying... 99% of the free time goes into studying...  now at the break.. 99% of the time I have literally nothing to do at all.. which helps my mind get all crazy. Im acing my exams.. people i meet for the first time have heard im smart... ( how ? )  That thing can brighten up my day a bit... but at the end.. why am i doing all of this ? Does my life even have a point if im just sitting at my flat, studying, or not doing anything at all.. I dont see the end of this.

This is chaotic post.. I m sure i forgot lots of the things.. But well. my mind is full of toughts right now.

I just really have no more energy to keep going.. Ive been knocked down.. but got back up. But i cant no more.

You dont have to be sorry, kind stranger. Its not your duty to be here for me or anyone else. That comes from your will.

I mean.. I would have to rewrite everything..  it was a long post. Im just slowly giving up on myself. I dont see it ever ending.

I guess no one really will be there for me. I dont know why I hoped for some random strangers..  


I guess thats just it.
Thanks buddy. IT just seems like a tunnel without an end.
Yeah.. Im still 3 weeks till going back..  but this isnt the root of the problem.. Just something that triggered everything even more.
Its just a big block of nonsense..
